ed4bba0188a081e9d29b4bd5f50d4779d5ec361b: Mijanès-Donezan is a low-key resort on a modest scale — 12 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. For families on a tight budget, or skiers who want to fit in plenty of days without breaking the bank, it is a sincere and often overlooked address.
